items: Added support for Automod actions and held messages.
Added support for real-time 7TV updates, like new emotes or emote set swaps.
Added detailed moderation actions when the user is a moderator.
Added a mod panel to manage chat modes like emote only or subscribers only.
Added visual support for cheermotes.
Added channel updates for when a channel's stream title or category changes.
Chat history now follows your deleted message appearance setting instead of being hidden.
Redesigned and improved the appearance of alerts like subs, announcements, and raids.
Added better emote picker subcategories to support earned global emotes.
Fixed emotes being indiced incorrectly when using emojis.
Fixed the wrapping of tooltips especially near the edges of the window.
Changed the behavior of paused scrolling. The message list will be frozen until the user resumes scrolling.
The sidebar is now collapsible at any window size instead of only on smaller screens.
Improved tooltips to be more performant and much less buggy.
Adjusted the background of the top bar of chat panes to look better.
Improved user card UX by progressively loading more info as it comes in.
Added enabling notifications as an optional onboarding step.
Fixed notifications not working properly when installed as an app.
Fixed the notification center not always being scrollable.
Fixed timestamp setting not being respected in user cards.
Fixed notifications not being marked as read when the channel was focused.
Fixed navigating to this very changelog when an update released.
Lots of small performance improvements to the app.
The initial public release of Peepochat.
